start: A workout running, MettleUp in the background (not closed), rest card on the lock screen

user_sees: The set is ticked in the workout
The next rest or the live card follows
must_not: A different set ticked than the one the card names

start: MettleUp swiped away, live workout card showing 'Complete set' for 'Bench Press, set 2'

user_sees: A rest card starts, naming the next set
The live card moves on to the next set
must_not: The workout clock stays paused after the tick

user_sees: Set 2 is ticked with the numbers the card showed

start: 'Rest is over' showing with 'Complete set', phone locked

must_not: No button anywhere for two minutes after the rest

start: MettleUp closed, the card names a set the phone cannot place (the last set, a set with no numbers, or a card over an hour old)

user_sees: 'MettleUp was closed. Open it within 10 min to log this set.'
must_not: A set ticked with numbers the member never saw
A rest started for a workout left open days ago
The tap lost although the app opened in time

start: MettleUp closed, 'Complete set' tapped once already

steps.action: Tap 'Complete set' again on a lagging copy (phone or watch)

start: Phone locked on a gym bench, live card on the lock screen

steps.action: Someone else taps 'Complete set' without unlocking
must_not: The lock screen showing more than the exercise, set and numbers
Anything beyond the member's own workout reachable without unlocking
